originalFailure.summary: Controller restart returned before the HTTP service was serving; initial Agent pause reported partial with detection cleanup false and strict launcher checks rejected it.

changes: Wait for the existing local controller before the first source mutation; no service start or restart is attempted.
Require readiness, a consistent two-source capacity/inventory restricted to the two saved identities, and exact OpenAPI application title.
Use a 60-second polling window and five-second timeout per GET; a final in-flight health/identity request can extend wall time beyond the polling deadline.
Keep the fully-ready idempotent path before controller admission checks.
Keep controller wait outside the mutation/rollback block, so a serving timeout does not pause sources or stop Isaac.
limits: No source or runtime changes performed by this agent.
The original failed recovery log is preserved; runtime startup and soak verification belong to a fresh run.
